title: Hallmark Recalls Cad Bane Christmas Tree Ornaments Due to Risk of Mold Exposure
summary: The brown paint on the exterior of the recalled Christmas tree ornaments did not fully dry before packaging, causing mold to grow on the exterior surface of the ornament, posing risk of respiratory issues to consumers due to mold exposure. Units: About 11,100.

title: Medical King Recalls About 222,000 Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Serious Entrapment and Asphyxia Hazards; One Death Reported
summary: When the recalled bed rails are attached to an adult's bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress. This poses a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. Units: About 222,000.

title: New Cosmos USA Recalls Combination Natural Gas and Carbon Monoxide Alarms Due to Failure to Alert Consumers to the Presence of Natural Gas and to the Risk of Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
summary: After alerting consumers to the presence of natural gas or carbon monoxide, the recalled alarm can go into sleep mode when the alert lasts less than four minutes. title: Outdoor Essentials Recalls Cultivar Planter Boxes Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Tractor Supply Company
summary: The recalled planter box frame can break, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 7,400.

title: Petidoux Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Burn Hazard; Violation of Federal Flammability Regulations for Children's Sleepwear
summary: The recalled children's pajamas violate the flammability regulations for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 620.

title: Stokke Recalls YOYO³ Strollers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The parking brake on the recalled strollers can disengage, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 2,890.

title: woom Bikes USA Recalls Children's OFF, OFF AIR and ORIGINAL 6 Bicycles Due to Fall and Crash Hazards
summary: The crank can break, due to fatigue fractures, causing the rider to lose control, posing fall and crash hazards. Units: About 2,500.

title: Baofali Crib Bumpers Recalled Due to Suffocation Hazard; Violation of Federal Ban on Crib Bumpers; Sold Exclusively on Temu.com by Unique Person Home Goods
summary: The recalled crib bumpers violate the federal crib bumper ban, posing a suffocation hazard to infants. Padded crib bumpers are banned by the federal Safe Sleep for Babies Act. Units: About 390.

title: Dreamgro Recalls Lullaby Travel Soothers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The recalled toy's gold-colored soft star can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 25,900.

title: GoveeLife and Govee Smart Electric Space Heaters Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Imported by Govee
summary: The smart electric space heaters can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Testing determined the smart electric space heaters do not comply with the voluntary industry safety standard, UL 1278, posing an overheating and fire risk from wireless control features. title: Guava Family Recalls Roam Strollers Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The stroller's brakes can fail to engage or unexpectedly disengage, posing fall and injury hazards to children. Units: About 8,500.

title: Kyte Baby Recalls Slumber Suits Due to Burn Hazard; Violation of Federal Flammability Regulations; Sold Exclusively on Kytebaby.com
summary: The recalled slumber suits violate federal flammability regulations for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 20,500.

title: Quad Lock MAG Battery Pack Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Imported by Quad Lock
summary: The battery pack in the chargers can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 13,700 (In addition, about 1,580 were sold in Canada).

title: Tala North America Recalls Battery Powered Portable Lamps Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electronic malfunction can cause the lamp's lightbulb to fail and the lithium battery to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,300.

title: Wolf Appliance Recalls Dual Fuel Ranges with Infrared Griddles Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The range can short-circuit if liquids boil over or are spilled and turn on the griddle unexpectedly, posing a burn and fire hazard. Units: About 44,000 (In addition, about 1,400 were sold in Canada).

title: Dorel Home Furnishings Recalls Dorel Wall Beds Due to Serious Impact and Crush Hazards
summary: The wall beds can detach from the wall and fall onto those nearby, posing serious impact and crush hazards. Units: About 69,300.

title: Segway Recalls Segway Ninebot P100 KickScooters Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The front fork of the recalled KickScooters can break, posing fall and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 1,400.

title: South Shore Cribs Recalled Due to Entrapment Hazard; Violation of Federal Regulation for Full Sized Cribs; Imported by South Shore Industries
summary: The spacing between some of the crib's slats is wider than allowed under the federal safety standard, posing an entrapment hazard to children. Units: About 1,200.

title: Todson Recalls Nerf Barrage Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury; Violation of Federal Regulations for Bicycle Helmets; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the retention system requirements of the mandatory federal safety regulations for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect the wearer in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 6,500.
